newsitem.title: DUBAI: Arab programme extends $8 mln to Credit Libanais.
newsitem.headline: Arab programme extends $8 mln to Credit Libanais.

text.p: The Arab Trade Financing Programme (ATFP) on Sunday said it extended an $8.5 million credit line to Lebanon's Credit Libanais bank.
The credit line would cover refinancing of some credit extended by the bank.

Launched in 1991 to develop and promote trade among Arab countries and make Arab products more competitive by extending lines of credit, the ATFP is 50 percent-owned by the Abu Dhabi-based Arab Monetary Fund -- the Arab world's main financial institution.
ATFP financing covers a variety of goods, except oil and gas, re-exports and used items.
Credit Libanais is 97 percent-owned by Lebanon's central bank.
